title: Settled Coverage-Type Changes in the TRICARE Retired Reserve Recall Paid-Month Credit
content:
**Rule.** Under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, a coverage-type change already settled for the most recently paid month of a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan changes what the recall paid-month credit returns: where a coverage-type change credit stands against that month's bill, that credit is taken off; where a coverage-type adjustment bill for that month has a payment posted against it, that adjustment is added; otherwise nothing is taken off or added.

**What counts as the change credit?** The total of the credits with reason coverage-type change that stand against the monthly bill of the most recently paid month.

**What counts as the adjustment?** The amount billed as coverage-type adjustment for that coverage month; it is added only where the adjustment bill has a payment posted against it.

**Both a change credit and a paid adjustment are on the ledger.** The first case applies: the change credit is taken off.

**Hypothetical.** A TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family purchaser divorced on 18 May and a coverage-type change credit of 387.33 stands against the May bill: 387.33 is taken off what the credit returns.
